protocol.selection: Eligible: each run original gate, adjusted reward lower bounds >=0 in each scenario and >0 in one; maximize worst-scenario mean reward difference; if none eligible select same score diagnostically; ties listed order. No training-seed winner selection.

policy.intervalNote: Shared episode seeds and three training runs; pooled episodes are not IID. Per-run Wilson intervals and paired crossed bootstrap reported separately.
